scope: Private review of the entire 051419c0 to 413f4527 two-path clipping repair; not a submitted final review head. Parent owns gitseq and formal acceptance.
conclusion: Checker BOM P3 7ccec93c is repaired in the tested exact source; no defect found in this narrow source/test delta.
delta: The decoder is removed. clipBytes iterates Unicode characters, counts their UTF-8 size until the next would exceed max, and slices the original string at the retained UTF-16 offset. The canonical recorded-refusal test adds preserved leading U+FEFF and a three-byte character that cannot fit in the two remaining bytes.
verifiedBehavior: The unchanged accepted recorded-Room fixture that failed on 508 now passes, preserving the legal leading U+FEFF in a recorded outside-claim refusal at exactly 8192 bytes.
Direct helper and fill preserve exactly 8192-byte text and cut one-byte-over ASCII text to the original prefix.
A supplementary character that fits exactly is preserved even when more text follows; one needing four bytes is omitted entirely when only three remain.
A three-byte character that fits exactly is preserved even when more text follows; one needing three bytes is omitted entirely when only two remain.
Leading U+FEFF stays in truncated and exact-fit text. The small-limit helper controls also preserve complete characters and return an empty prefix when no complete character fits.
The canonical group still verifies that unrecorded refusal slots accept only the Room lane/generation forms and that recorded reason/fix remain bounded and stop at character boundaries.

compilation: Full npm run typecheck across all workspaces, production source and tests including both independent fixtures, exited 0 before any runtime command.
limits: The two canonical wording tests are credited; 29 other audit2 tests are skipped and receive no credit. No old whole-coverage run was repeated.

The new direct fill boundary cases test the helper with caller-supplied facts; they do not prove that arbitrary facts are admissible through the Room API. The unchanged recorded-Room fixture and canonical group provide actual admission/refusal coverage.

No full stage approval, original seven-condition completion, mutation-inventory claim, moving producer-count claim, or stage4 lifecycle completion is inferred. Every original declaration-field/new-admission-guard mutation condition remains owed on the final exact head.
The changed G2:fill-bound-character predicate is now the byte-limit break inside character iteration; prior decoder/continuation-loop mutation targets do not constitute evidence for this new source.
